sources.title: Chinese in East Timor: Former Portuguese colony a model of integration by immigrants from China
sources.provider: Asia Pacific Solidarity Network / attributed Randy Mulyanto, South China Morning Post
sources.quality_notes: Direct lines9–20 explicitly describe qiu qian numbered sticks and translation of slips. Original publisher index corroborates attribution; direct article unavailable, same report not two independent records. Distinct from 2002 article, not a natal-method witness.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: Cross-border E-Bazi clients do not prove local Brunei teaching or lineage.
Promotional Four Pillars explanation does not prove actual local teaching or an opening date.
Horoscope label on fortune-stick divination does not establish Ziwei or Ziping.
unresolved_lineage_questions: Brunei original press and actual local practice; independently dated local Ziwei and Bazi in both regions; original Timor reports.
